input.description: What a useful project can omit

expected.summary: Decides whether generic USTX generation would improve on MIDI.

observed.summary: Only what OpenUtau itself writes was exercised. The minimal-project question is deferred.

classification_note: Not tested in this phase. Whether a project may omit singer, expressions or renderer settings is not established beyond the observation that a track with no singer saves without one and exports an empty stem (A15). A generated project should therefore carry everything an OpenUtau-saved project carries until a minimal form is verified per version.

details.known: a track without singer is accepted and renders an empty WAV silently (A15)
